verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents Model Context Protocol support for connecting Dialpad with AI tools and agents. This is the product's own capability and would let a user drive Dialpad through natural-language commands in an AI client, but the evidence is a single overview line with no detail on scope or operations. The AI voice and digital agents serve customer conversations, not users operating the product, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which actions the MCP integration exposes, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
